core_aesthetic_takeaways: The case is valuable because it turns heritage into a sequence of actions, not a background pattern.
The strongest reusable structure is the narrative loop: everyday village, threshold, ritual token, mural awakening, hero emergence, group formation, inheritance.
A role-based hero taxonomy can stabilize AIGC character continuity across still frames and animation tests.
Warm folk atmosphere should be controlled through palette, light and one focal event per frame, not through unlimited ornaments.
For competition use, the AIGC process itself should be presented as evidence: research, script, character bible, storyboard, prompt packet, continuity QA and application proof.
prompt_structure_lessons: Lock the project context first: Culture China, university competition, public cultural storytelling, or AIGC picturebook.
Name the cultural story engine before describing visual style.
Separate scene beats, character taxonomy, visual palette, typography rules and continuity checks.
Require one focal action per frame to prevent fragmented image noise.
Use exact cultural terms only after verification; otherwise use neutral placeholder labels.

safe_exact_text_candidates: short section labels such as story script, character system, storyboard, visual style and production path
verified names of cultural topics supplied by the user
requires_source_confirmation: WeChat account metadata and watermark text
text_accuracy_policy.training_rule: Use the source for derived structure and aesthetic grammar only. Do not train full article text, original images, dialogue or unverified microcopy.

risk_controls.risk: copyright contamination from external article images
risk_controls.mitigation: Store metadata and derived aesthetic rules only; keep source URL for citation; require rights clearance before image ingestion.
Require every motif to serve a scene action, taxonomy role, storyboard beat or process explanation.

risk_controls.risk: character continuity drift in AIGC animation
risk_controls.mitigation: Use a character bible with face color, prop, silhouette, gesture, role and scene function before generating frames.
Use controlled warm palette, focal lighting, negative space and one major action per frame.
Tag uncertain content as placeholder or research-needed instead of presenting it as exact text.

negative_prompt_atoms: generic red gold Chinese festival clutter
all scenes at the same intensity

recommended_training_use.stage_1_curation: Keep as metadata-only external reference with source URL and no image ingestion.
recommended_training_use.stage_2_caption_tuning: Use captions to teach cultural story engines, storyboard loops, character taxonomy and AIGC production boards.
recommended_training_use.stage_3_lora_training: If rights are cleared later, add selected images to a short-video-aigc and Culture China subset with separate continuity tags.
recommended_training_use.stage_4_prompt_runtime: Retrieve when prompts mention AIGC picturebook, heritage animation, Yingge, folk ritual storytelling, Culture China, university competition process board or storyboard.
